title: Support
description: We're here to help. Email us, or follow a guide to get things done in Emploist.

contact.title: Email us
contact.description: Questions, feedback, or something not working? We usually reply within 24 hours.

guideList.title: Guides
guideList.description: Step-by-step help with the main parts of Emploist.

createJob.title: Create and publish a job
createJob.summary: Describe the role, save a draft, and publish it.

describe.title: Describe the role
describe.body: On the <ui>Details</ui> tab, add a <ui>Job title</ui> and a <ui>Description</ui>. The department, location, work mode, and employment type are optional. Departments and locations you add are offered again on later jobs.

formAndStages.title: Check the form and stages
formAndStages.body: The <ui>Application form</ui> and <ui>Stages</ui> tabs start with a ready-to-use setup. You can adjust them now or at any time later.

saveOrPublish.title: Save or publish
saveOrPublish.body: <ui>Save draft</ui> keeps the job private to your team. <ui>Publish</ui> puts it on your careers page.

applicationForm.title: Build the application form
applicationForm.summary: Choose what applicants fill in when they apply.

open.title: Open the form
open.body: Open the <ui>Application form</ui> tab of a job.

essentials.title: Start with the essentials
essentials.body: Every form asks for a <ui>Full name</ui>, an <ui>Email</ui>, and a <ui>Resume or CV</ui>. You can move them, but not remove them.

addQuestions.title: Add questions
addQuestions.body: Click <ui>Add</ui> and choose a question type, such as <ui>Short answer</ui>, <ui>Single choice</ui>, or <ui>Linear scale</ui>. Add a <ui>Heading</ui> or <ui>Text</ui> to give applicants more context.

setUp.title: Set each one up
setUp.body: Click a question to edit it, and turn on <ui>Required</ui> if applicants must answer it. Drag questions, or use their menu, to change the order. Questions marked <ui>Incomplete</ui> need finishing before you publish.

save.title: Save your changes
save.body: On an existing job, click <ui>Save changes</ui>. Your changes only apply to new applications. Ones you already have keep the questions they answered.

stages.title: Set up hiring stages
stages.summary: Shape the steps every application moves through.

open.title: Open the stages
open.body: Open a job's <ui>Stages</ui> tab. New jobs start with <ui>Inbox</ui>, <ui>Interviewing</ui>, <ui>Accepted</ui>, and <ui>Rejected</ui>.

inbox.title: Get to know the inbox
inbox.body: New applications arrive in the first stage, the inbox. You can rename it, but it always stays first and can't be deleted.

addRenameReorder.title: Add, rename, and reorder
addRenameReorder.body: Click <ui>Add stage</ui> to add one, or choose <ui>Rename</ui> from a stage's menu. Drag stages into the order you hire in.

delete.title: Delete a stage
delete.body: Choose <ui>Delete</ui> from a stage's menu. If it has applications, you'll choose which stage they move to.

reviewApplications.title: Review applications
reviewApplications.summary: Find, read, and move applications through your stages.

openJob.title: Open a job
openJob.body: Open a job from <jobs>Jobs</jobs>. Its <ui>Applications</ui> tab has a pill for each stage, showing how many applications are in it.

find.title: Find who to review
find.body: Search by name or email, and sort by <ui>Best match</ui>, <ui>Newest first</ui>, or <ui>Oldest first</ui>. Best match is available while AI features are on.

openApplication.title: Open an application
openApplication.body: Click a name to open the application. Click <ui>View resume</ui> to open their resume in a new tab. Press <ui>←</ui> or <ui>→</ui> to go to the previous or next application.

move.title: Move it to a stage
move.body: Choose a stage from the <ui>Stage</ui> menu in the application, or from <ui>Move to</ui> in a row's menu. If you move one by mistake, click <ui>Undo</ui> in the message that appears.

comments.title: Comment and mention teammates
comments.summary: Discuss applicants with your team, and stay in the loop.

write.title: Write a comment
write.body: Open an application, write in the comment box, and click <ui>Comment</ui>, or press <ui>{{shortcut}}</ui>. Only your team sees comments.

mention.title: Mention someone
mention.body: Type <ui>@</ui> and choose a teammate to let them know.

replies.title: Keep up with replies
replies.body: You're notified when someone mentions you, or comments on an application you've commented on. Find these under the bell at the top of the page, or in <notifications>Notifications</notifications>.

editOrDelete.title: Edit or delete
editOrDelete.body: Use a comment's menu to <ui>Edit</ui> or <ui>Delete</ui> your own comments. Admins can also delete anyone's comments.

manageJob.title: Close, archive, or duplicate a job
manageJob.summary: Stop taking applications, tidy up, or reuse a job.

closeOrReopen.title: Close or reopen
closeOrReopen.body: On a published job, use the status menu at the top: <ui>Closed</ui> stops taking applications, and <ui>Open</ui> starts again.

duplicate.title: Duplicate
duplicate.body: Choose <ui>Duplicate</ui> from a job's <ui>More actions</ui> menu to start a draft with the same details, form, and stages.

archive.title: Archive
archive.body: Choose <ui>Archive</ui> from <ui>More actions</ui> to put a job away. Archived jobs are read-only. Click <ui>Restore</ui> to bring one back.

delete.title: Delete
delete.body: Choose <ui>Delete</ui> from <ui>More actions</ui> to remove a job for good, along with its applications. If you'd like to keep them, archive the job instead.

exportApplications.title: Export applications
exportApplications.summary: Download a job's applications and resumes.

start.title: Start the export
start.body: On a job with applications, open <ui>More actions</ui> and choose <ui>Export applications</ui>.

openZip.title: Open the ZIP file
openZip.body: <ui>{{file}}</ui> is a spreadsheet with a row for each application. The <ui>{{folder}}</ui> folder has every resume, named after the applicant.

customizeCareersPage.title: Customize your careers page
customizeCareersPage.summary: Choose your color, or edit the page's code.

color.title: Pick a color
color.body: Open the <design>Design</design> tab in Careers page, choose a <ui>Primary color</ui>, and click <ui>Save color</ui>. It's used for buttons and highlights.

code.title: Edit the code
code.body: Click <ui>Edit code</ui> to change the page's templates and styles. <ui>Reference</ui> lists everything you can use in them.

preview.title: Preview as you go
preview.body: The preview updates as you type. Use <ui>Go to page</ui> to check each page, and switch between desktop and mobile sizes.

save.title: Save
save.body: Click <ui>Save</ui>. To start over, choose <ui>Reset to default code</ui> from <ui>More actions</ui>.

editCodeLocally.title: Edit the code on your computer
editCodeLocally.summary: Work in your own editor, with a live preview.

download.title: Download the code
download.body: On the <design>Design</design> tab, click <ui>Download ZIP</ui> and unzip it.

preview.title: Preview it
preview.body: With Node.js {{version}} or later, run {{command}} in the folder and open {{url}}. It shows your page with sample jobs. Reload it after each change.

check.title: Check for problems
check.body: Run {{command}} to find the same problems that saving would.

upload.title: Upload it
upload.body: Zip the files, click <ui>Upload ZIP</ui>, check the preview, and click <ui>Save</ui>.

changeAddress.title: Change your careers page address
changeAddress.summary: Move your page to a new Emploist address.

open.title: Open the address
open.body: Open the <domain>Domain</domain> tab in Careers page, and click <ui>Change</ui>.

choose.title: Choose a new one
choose.body: Type the address you'd like. We'll check that it's available as you type.

confirm.title: Confirm the change
confirm.body: Click <ui>Change address</ui>. Your old address stops working right away, including links to jobs you've shared, and another company could then use it.

customDomain.title: Connect your own domain
customDomain.summary: Show your careers page at an address on your website.

add.title: Add your domain
add.body: On the <domain>Domain</domain> tab, enter a subdomain of your website, like careers.acme.com, and click <ui>Add domain</ui>. Main domains, like acme.com, can't be connected.

records.title: Add two DNS records
records.body: Where you manage your domain, add the <ui>CNAME</ui> and <ui>TXT</ui> records shown, using the copy buttons. On Cloudflare, set the CNAME record to DNS only.

wait.title: Wait for the check
wait.body: Changes usually show up within minutes, but can take up to 48 hours. Once it says <ui>Connected</ui>, your careers page is at your domain.

inviteTeam.title: Invite your team
inviteTeam.summary: Add teammates by email, and choose their roles.

send.title: Send an invitation
send.body: Open the <members>Members</members> tab in Settings, click <ui>Invite member</ui>, enter their email address, and click <ui>Send invitation</ui>.

role.title: Choose a role
role.body: <ui>Members</ui> work on jobs and applications. <ui>Admins</ui> can also manage the team, company settings, careers page, and billing.

join.title: They join
join.body_one: They'll get an email with a link to join, which works for {{count, number}} day.
join.body_other: They'll get an email with a link to join, which works for {{count, number}} days.

followUp.title: Follow up
followUp.body: Invitations waiting for an answer are listed under <ui>Pending invitations</ui>. Use an invitation's menu to <ui>Resend invitation</ui> or <ui>Cancel invitation</ui>.

manageMembers.title: Manage roles and members
manageMembers.summary: Change roles, remove people, or leave a company.

changeRole.title: Change a role
changeRole.body: On the <members>Members</members> tab in Settings, open someone's menu and choose <ui>Make admin</ui> or <ui>Make member</ui>. Only admins can change roles.

remove.title: Remove someone
remove.body: Choose <ui>Remove from company</ui> from their menu. They lose access right away. Only admins can remove people.

leave.title: Leave the company
leave.body: Choose <ui>Leave company</ui> from your own menu. If you're the only admin, make someone else an admin first.

deleteCompanyOrAccount.title: Delete your company or account
deleteCompanyOrAccount.summary: Permanently remove your company, or only your own account.

open.title: Open the Danger zone
open.body: Open the <danger>Danger zone</danger> tab in Settings.

deleteCompany.title: Delete the company
deleteCompany.body: Admins can click <ui>Delete company</ui>. Everything in it is deleted, including jobs, applications, and your careers page, and your plan is canceled right away with no refund.

deleteAccount.title: Or delete your account
deleteAccount.body: Click <ui>Delete account</ui>. If you're the only admin, make someone else an admin first. If you're the only person in the company, it's deleted too.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.body: Type the company's name or your email, and click the delete button. This can't be undone.

stageEmails.title: Email applicants at each stage
stageEmails.summary: Let applicants know when they apply or move ahead.

open.title: Open a stage's email
open.body: On a job's <ui>Stages</ui> tab, click <ui>Edit email</ui> next to a stage.

customize.title: Make it yours
customize.body: Each stage comes with an email ready to go. Edit its Subject and Message, and add details like the applicant's first name with Add variable, or by typing {{character}}.

preview.title: Preview and turn it on
preview.body: Check the <ui>Preview</ui>, which uses a sample applicant. Then turn on <ui>Send this email</ui> and click <ui>Save</ui>.

timing.title: Know when it's sent
timing.body_one: The inbox's email goes out as soon as someone applies. Other stages wait {{count, number}} minute after a move, so undoing it, or moving the application on, cancels the email.
timing.body_other: The inbox's email goes out as soon as someone applies. Other stages wait {{count, number}} minutes after a move, so undoing it, or moving the application on, cancels the email.

pause.title: Pause every email
pause.body: Admins can turn off <ui>Email applicants</ui> on the <general>General</general> tab in Settings to stop emails from every stage.

repliesLayout.title: Set up replies and the email layout
repliesLayout.summary: Choose where replies go and how emails look.

replyTo.title: Add a reply-to address
replyTo.body: In <emails>Emails</emails>, enter a <ui>Reply-to address</ui> your team checks, and click <ui>Save address</ui>. Without one, replies from applicants won't reach you.

layout.title: Edit the layout
layout.body: Every email is sent in your layout, with your logo and primary color. Click Edit code to change its HTML, and keep {{placeholder}} where each stage's message goes.

save.title: Save
save.body: Click <ui>Save</ui>. To start over, choose <ui>Reset to default layout</ui> from <ui>More actions</ui>.

matchScores.title: Understand match scores
matchScores.summary: How AI ranks applications against their job.

read.title: Read the score
read.body: Each application gets a match from 0 to 100% against its job's details.

aspects.title: See what's behind it
aspects.body: Open an application to see how it scores on <ui>Skills</ui>, <ui>Experience</ui>, <ui>Seniority fit</ui>, and <ui>Qualifications</ui>. Qualifications only count when the job asks for degrees, certifications, or licenses.

useAsGuide.title: Use it as a guide
useAsGuide.body: Matches help you decide who to review first. Use them alongside your own review, not instead of it.

noScore.title: When there's no score
noScore.body: <ui>Ranking</ui> means it's on its way, and <ui>Needs credits</ui> means you're out of AI credits. <ui>Not ranked</ui> means it couldn't be ranked, for example when a resume is a scanned image. If ranking failed, click <ui>Try again</ui> in the application.

rankAgain.title: Rank again after edits
rankAgain.body: When you change a job's title, department, employment type, or description, choose <ui>Save and rank again</ui> to rank its applications against the new details.

aiSwitch.title: Turn AI ranking off or on
aiSwitch.summary: Choose whether your applications are ranked with AI.

find.title: Find the switch
find.body: On the <general>General</general> tab in Settings, turn <ui>Rank applications with AI</ui> off or on. It applies to your whole company.

whileOff.title: While it's off
whileOff.body: Nothing is sent to AI, match scores are hidden, and new applications aren't ranked. Earlier scores come back when you turn it on again.

turnOn.title: Turn it back on
turnOn.body: If applications came in meanwhile, you'll choose whether to rank them, using a credit each, or to leave them unranked.

tellApplicants.title: Let applicants know
tellApplicants.body: While AI ranking is on, the default careers page tells applicants that AI helps review applications. If you use your own code, add this yourself.

planCredits.title: Manage your plan and credits
planCredits.summary: Your trial, your subscription, and AI credits.

startTrial.title: Start your free trial
startTrial.body_one: In <billing>Billing</billing>, choose <ui>Monthly</ui> or <ui>Yearly</ui>, then click <ui>Start free trial</ui>. It lasts {{count, number}} day and comes with {{credits}}.
startTrial.body_other: In <billing>Billing</billing>, choose <ui>Monthly</ui> or <ui>Yearly</ui>, then click <ui>Start free trial</ui>. It lasts {{count, number}} days and comes with {{credits}}.

plan.title: Your plan
plan.body: Monthly is {{monthlyPrice}} a month, with {{monthlyCredits}} each month. Yearly is {{yearlyPrice}} a year, with {{yearlyCredits}} up front. Unused credits don't carry over. Click <ui>Manage subscription</ui> to update your card, see invoices, or cancel.

switchToYearly.title: Switch to yearly
switchToYearly.body: In <billing>Billing</billing>, choose <ui>Yearly</ui> on your plan, then click <ui>Switch to yearly</ui>. You pay {{price}} now, minus the unused days of your current month. If you're on the free trial, you pay when it ends instead.

buyCredits.title: Buy more credits
buyCredits.body: Each application ranked by AI uses one credit. For more, buy a pack under <ui>Buy credits</ui>. Top-up credits never expire, and they're used after your plan's credits.

runOut.title: If you run out
runOut.body: New applications wait as <ui>Needs credits</ui>. Once you have credits again, rank them from the notice in <jobs>Jobs</jobs> or <billing>Billing</billing>, or leave them unranked.

endTrial.title: End your trial early
endTrial.body: If your trial's credits run out, click <ui>End trial</ui> in the notice in <jobs>Jobs</jobs> or <billing>Billing</billing>. Your plan starts today, with its credits.

planStops.title: If your plan stops
planStops.body: Without a working plan, Emploist is read-only and your careers page stops taking applications. Your team can still see everything and export applications, and admins can subscribe again.

connectAssistant.title: Connect an AI assistant
connectAssistant.summary: Manage your jobs and applications from Claude, ChatGPT, and other assistants.

choose.title: Choose your assistant
choose.body: On the <mcp>MCP</mcp> page, choose your assistant under <ui>Connect your assistant</ui>.

follow.title: Follow its steps
follow.body: Each assistant has its own steps, with the address to paste or the command to copy right where you need it.

allow.title: Sign in and allow
allow.body: Sign in to Emploist when your assistant asks, and click <ui>Allow</ui>. Your assistant works as you, with your role.

disconnect.title: Disconnect it
disconnect.body: To stop an assistant, click <ui>Disconnect</ui> next to it under <ui>Connected assistants</ui> on the <mcp>MCP</mcp> page.

mcpSwitch.title: Turn MCP off or on
mcpSwitch.summary: Choose whether your team can use Emploist from AI assistants.

find.title: Find the switch
find.body: On the <general>General</general> tab in Settings, turn <ui>Let your team connect AI assistants</ui> off or on. It applies to your whole company.

whileOff.title: While it's off
whileOff.body: Assistants can't use Emploist, and no one can connect a new one. Connections are kept, so they work again when you turn MCP back on.
